blocks.text: This agreement is made between Acme Corp and Globex Ltd on 1 March 2024. It sets out the terms under which consulting services are provided.
In this agreement, Services means the consulting services described in Schedule 1.
Headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.
The Client shall pay the fees set out below within 30 days of each invoice.

| Service | Rate | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Consulting | EUR 1,200 | per day |
| Support | EUR 300 | per month |
Either party may terminate this agreement by giving ninety (90) days written notice to the other party.
